claims: The Artemis II mission is estimated to cost approximately $4.1 billion per launch.
The approximately $4.1 billion per launch cost estimate for the Artemis II mission covers the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The approximately $4.1 billion per launch cost estimate for the Artemis II mission covers the Orion capsule for the crewed lunar flyby.
The broader Artemis program is expected to cost over $90 billion through 2025.
The per launch cost for Artemis II is ~$4.1 - $4.2 billion.
The Orion capsule cost is roughly $9.3 billion total through the second flight.
The ground systems cost is estimated at $568 million annually.
The development of the SLS rocket has cost roughly $24 billion to date.
The development of the Orion spacecraft has cost over $20 billion to date.
The Artemis program is largely funded by American taxpayers.
